name: Odd Instruments of the World
subtitle: Saw, Glasses, Washtub & more
shortDescription: 7 unusual homemade and folk instruments to play: Washtub bass, Musical saw, Musical glasses and Glass harmonica.
longDescription:
Odd Instruments of the World: 7 unusual homemade and folk instruments from around the world, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Washtub bass, Musical saw, Musical glasses, Glass harmonica, Friction drum, Ugly stick and Rainstick.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can bow a saw, rub the rims of glasses, pluck a washtub bass, thump an ugly stick and tilt a rainstick, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
